facts.text: Ada shows Ines the salt from the main wheel, and Tomas admits he lent the key to Mr Hale

facts.text: Salt would not stop a clock by chance, so somebody opened the case with the key and put it there

anchor.quote: Somebody had opened the case with the key

facts.text: Only two keys exist: the keeper's and the one he left with Ines
Tomas lent the key to Mr Hale for one evening, three days before, for a silver coin

facts.text: Tomas says he did not know what Mr Hale meant to do

facts.text: Ada mends the clock; at noon it strikes, the lamp turns and the three boats come in

facts.text: Mr Hale thanks Ada and asks Ines for the key; Ines says her father will decide on Friday
Ines hides the key in the hollow base of the kitchen lamp

anchor.quote: hid it inside the hollow base of the lamp

facts.text: Ada will stay in Kessel until the church clock is mended, and keeps the salt
